links.outcome: Sensitivity and specificity of delirium model on external hospital data against chart-review reference
links.effect: DEMO predicted 59 of 75 delirium cases (sensitivity 0.79, 95% CI 0.68-0.87; specificity 0.75, 95% CI 0.72-0.77); acceptable performance externally.
links.quote: The DEMO predicted 59 out of 75 delirium cases (sensitivity 0.79, 95% CI = 0.68-0.87; specificity 0.75, 95% CI = 0.72-0.77).

links.outcome: DEMO performance compared with manual VMS-questions on same admissions
links.effect: DEMO had lower specificity (0.64 vs. 0.72; p < 0.001) and comparable sensitivity (0.83 vs. 0.80; p = 0.56) in patients ≥70 years.
links.quote: Compared to the VMS-questions, the DEMO showed a lower specificity (0.64 vs. 0.72; p < 0.001) and a comparable sensitivity (0.83 vs. 0.80; p = 0.56).

screen.reason: Retrospective external validation of an automated delirium prediction model (DEMO) compared to manual screening questions.
